title: Scan hangs on long quoted strings: PATH_OR_PROSE_STRING backtracks cubically
description: CLI 0.0.28 scan never finishes on dubinc/dub (killed after 30-40 min). One 6 KB .tsx with one inline SVG path takes 18 s. CPU profile: 78% in PATH_OR_PROSE_STRING (src/pii-signals/match-pii-signals.ts:210-211, added in 19ce1d13). The prose branch has three adjacent "any non-quote char" runs separated by \s, and that class also matches whitespace, so a quoted string that starts with a capital and does not end in .!? backtracks O(n^3). Fix: make the match linear with identical results; audit other regexes in src/pii-signals and src/patterns for the same shape.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: PATH_OR_PROSE_STRING (src/pii-signals/match-pii-signals.ts:210, from 19ce1d13) had three adjacent runs that all take whitespace, so a quoted capitalised string not ending in .!? backtracked O(n^3). Same shape found in IMPORT_LINE (`from a import` + spaces), isJavaFieldDeclarationLine (`private` + spaces) and the localCopy pattern in occurrence-group.ts (type annotation + spaces), all cubic; `validates(?:_\w+)*` was exponential; the PascalCase phone check and the assigned-function check were quadratic. Fix: rewrite each so no two adjacent runs share characters; matches (and capture groups) unchanged, checked by old-vs-new fuzzing. Results: 6 KB SVG fixture 18.6 s -> 0.5 s; dubinc/dub (HEAD 20ca899) never finished before, now 95 s, 899 MB peak RSS. calcom, chatwoot, saleor, medusa, directus outputs byte-identical to develop apart from scanDurationMs. 1613 jest tests pass, tsc and lint clean. Not changed: python.ts DRF decorator `\[\s*([^\]]+)\]`, jvm.ts annotation-arg regexes, occurrence-group receiver chain (quadratic only, on short decorator/annotation text or start positions). PR pending.
